rules.beforeNativeFailure: The published exhaustive original-disagreement selection contains 131 explicit visually_complete/native-failure episodes. Other original native failures count as incomplete under the reporting convention; this does not assert their exact raw outcomes.
rules.nativeSuccess: Counts as complete in the reporting matrix, regardless of missing self-assessment.
rules.revisedFailure: Use the recorded final assessment or the separately sourced author confirmation. A verified missing finish counts as incomplete. Raw unavailable assessments remain null.
rules.timeout: The selected local timeout has no finish assessment; count as benchmark failure and incomplete under the reporting convention.
rules.composite: Retain the other 369 original records and substitute the 131 selected reruns.
rules.authorConfirmation: The project author confirmed that all 36 listed V4 failures remain agent-benchmark disagreements on 2026-09-24. This confirmation supplies their classification, not a recovered raw finish assessment.
